column3: “strike and kill” renders “strike down … fatally wounded.”
“Benjamin did not know” renders “they did not know.”
“gave ground” renders “gave place”; “relied on” renders “trusted to.”
“a great cloud of smoke” renders “a great rising of smoke.”
“Surely they are defeated” renders the doubled verb.
“the whole city was going up in smoke” renders “the whole of the city went up.”
“the men of Benjamin” renders the collective “the man of Benjamin.”
“turned their backs” renders “turned”; “them” renders the Hebrew singular “him.”
“without rest” renders a word read as “rest” or as the place name “Menuhah.”
“the entire city” renders “the city of soundness,” which some read as “men”; the meaning is uncertain.
